mapper.select: /* ProjectMainDao.getProjectMain */ select a.odoc_sn , a.user_id , a.odoc_nm , to_char(a.frst_reg_dt, 'YYYY. MM. DD') as frst_reg_dt , a.end_yn , a.odoc_type , TO_CHAR((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'MM') AS odoc_month , ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(b.odoc_dt))::numeric / EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('month', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day') * 100 , 1) AS progress , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_odoc_dtl d WHERE d.user_id = a.user_id AND d.odoc_sn = a.odoc_sn AND d.odoc_dt >= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AND d.odoc_dt < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date + interval '1 day' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS odoc_yn , a.odoc_fav_yn , a.odoc_thema_type , CASE WHEN a.stream_mdf_dt is not null AND a.stream_mdf_dt between (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1 AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') THEN a.stream_sn ELSE 0 END as stream_sn , a.max_stream_sn , COALESCE(to_char(a.odoc_alarm_time, 'HH24:MI'), '00:00') as odoc_alarm_time , a.odoc_alarm_yn from t_odoc_main a left join t_odoc_dtl b on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.odoc_sn = b.odoc_sn and b.odoc_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) and b.odoc_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) + INTERVAL '1 month' where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.odoc_sn = #{odocSn} group by a.odoc_sn, a.user_id, a.odoc_nm, a.frst_reg_dt, a.end_yn

/* ProjectMainDao.getHistYearList */ select TO_CHAR(b.odoc_dt, 'YYYY') AS year , TO_CHAR(b.odoc_dt, 'MM') AS month , ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(b.odoc_dt))::numeric / EXTRACT( DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('month', b.odoc_dt) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day' ) * 100 , 1) AS progress , a.odoc_thema_type from t_odoc_main a left join t_odoc_dtl b on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.odoc_sn = b.odoc_sn where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.odoc_sn = #{odocSn} and b.odoc_dt IS NOT NULL group by TO_CHAR(b.odoc_dt, 'YYYY'), TO_CHAR(b.odoc_dt, 'MM'), DATE_TRUNC('month', b.odoc_dt), a.odoc_thema_type order by year desc, month desc

/* ProjectMainDao.getHistMonth */ select a.odoc_nm ,CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', a.frst_reg_dt) = DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month}, 'YYYY-MM')) THEN TO_CHAR(a.frst_reg_dt, 'DD')::int ELSE NULL END AS created_day , ARRAY_TO_STRING( ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(DATE(b.odoc_dt), 'DD')), ',' ) AS checked_dates , ARRAY_TO_STRING( ARRAY_AGG(to_char(b.odoc_dt, 'HH24시 MI분')), ',' ) AS checked_timestamps , ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(b.odoc_dt))::numeric / EXTRACT( DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month}, 'YYYY-MM')) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day' ) * 100 , 1) AS progress , a.odoc_thema_type , a.odoc_type from t_odoc_main a left join t_odoc_dtl b on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.odoc_sn = b.odoc_sn and b.odoc_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month}, 'YYYY-MM')) and b.odoc_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month}, 'YYYY-MM')) + INTERVAL '1 month' where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.odoc_sn = #{odocSn} group by a.odoc_nm, a.frst_reg_dt, a.odoc_thema_type, a.odoc_type
mapper.update: WITH prev AS ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_odoc_dtl d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.odoc_sn = #{odocSn} AND d.odoc_dt >= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - interval '1 day' AND d.odoc_dt < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ) AS has_prev ) UPDATE t_odoc_main m SET stream_sn = CASE WHEN prev.has_prev THEN COALESCE(m.stream_sn,0)+1 ELSE 1 END , max_stream_sn = GREATEST( COALESCE(m.max_stream_sn, 0), CASE WHEN prev.has_prev THEN COALESCE(m.stream_sn,0)+1 ELSE 1 END ) , stream_mdf_dt = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') FROM prev WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.odoc_sn = #{odocSn}

UPDATE T_USER u SET max_stream_sn = GREATEST( COALESCE(u.max_stream_sn, 0), COALESCE(m.max_stream_sn, 0) ), LAST_MDF_DT = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') FROM ( SELECT user_id , MAX(max_stream_sn) AS max_stream_sn FROM t_odoc_main WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id ) m WHERE u.user_id = m.user_id
